answers.rationale: The requirement specifies accessories for medium-voltage switchgear, such as NEMA pads and insulating boots. These are catalog items listed under 'CROWN-ACC' in the CROWN business unit.

The requirement specifies medium-voltage switchgear with bus sections and a tie breaker. This matches the description of 'CROWN-ARMV' in the CROWN business unit, which provides arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear with bus sections and tie breakers.

The requirement specifies relays, controls, and associated accessories for a functional system. This aligns with 'EP2-RPP' in the EP2 business unit, which provides relay and protection panels with the necessary relays, controls, and accessories.
